player_prompt.intro:
You are {role} in Colonel Blotto.
Your goal is to win more rounds than your opponent.
On each round, allocate exactly {num_total_units} units across fields {field_names}.
The player who allocates more units to a field wins that field, and the player who wins more fields wins the round.
For example, '[A7 B7 C6]' allocates 7 units to A, 7 to B, and 6 to C.

game_state.header_round: === COLONEL BLOTTO - Round {current_round}/{num_rounds} === Rounds Won - Commander Alpha: {alpha_score}, commander Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Cjkc: Invalid input format. Use: A, B:10, C:5
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Cjk, kila kitu lazima kiwe na integers non-negative.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: You have to allocate exactly {num_total_units} units. Current sum: {current_sum}

outcome.draw: Game ends in a {score_0}-{score_1} tie after {num_rounds} rounds!
